title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Full-time

About the Role

arge manufacturing company is looking for a motivated and commercially minded Sales Executive to join their Retaining Walls Department. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building strong customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and delivering tailored solutions to meet customer needs.

Working closely with the Retaining Walls team, you will play a key role in driving sales, managing projects from initial enquiry through to completion, and developing relationships with both existing customers and new clients.

The role offers a varied mix of sales, business development, technical quotation work, supplier liaison, and customer engagement, including office and site visits.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage the full sales cycle for Poundfield's retaining wall products, from initial enquiry and quotation through to order completion.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers while identifying and developing new business opportunities.
- Respond promptly and professionally to customer enquiries by telephone, email, and in person.
- Interpret technical drawings and prepare accurate, competitive project quotations.
- Develop a thorough understanding of our products, manufacturing processes, and technical capabilities.
- Obtain and compare costs from existing and new suppliers, supporting effective procurement.
- Maintain commercial awareness and develop a strong network of industry contacts.
- Use Barbour ABI to identify potential projects, leads, and business development opportunities.
- Visit customers and clients for office meetings and site visits.
- Support the company's presence at trade shows, industry events, and CPD presentations.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues across the department to support sales growth and customer satisfaction.
- Maintain high standards of accuracy, professionalism, confidentiality, and adherence to company quality, health and safety, and environmental policies.

About You

They are looking for someone who is proactive, organised, and confident communicating with customers and colleagues. You will have a commercial mindset, a strong customer focus, and the ability to manage multiple enquiries and projects effectively.

You will ideally have:
- Experience in a sales, business development, or customer-facing commercial role.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- Good numerical skills and attention to detail when preparing quotations and sourcing costs.
- The ability to understand technical drawings, or a willingness to develop this skill.
- A proactive approach to identifying new business opportunities and developing customer relationships.
- Confidence working independently while contributing positively to a team.

Experience in construction, precast concrete, retaining walls, or a related technical sales environment would be advantageous. Familiarity with Barbour ABI would also be beneficial.

title: Trainee Sales Advisor
description:
Trainee Insurance Sales Advisor / Junior Sales Advisor

Location: Ipswich, Suffolk (On-site)

Salary: £21,000 - £26,000 per annum

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Experience Level: Entry Level / Trainee (No experience required)

Are you looking to launch a rewarding, fast-paced career in the financial services sector? Massenhove Recruitment Limited is seeking a motivated Trainee Insurance Sales Advisor / Junior Sales Assistant to join a growing team in Ipswich, Suffolk.

This is an exceptional entry-level sales opportunity. You will receive industry-leading training on insurance products, regulations, and customer management, making it the perfect stepping stone for an ambitious individual looking for career progression.

Role Purpose & Overview

As an Insurance Sales Advisor, you will be the first point of contact for clients across the UK looking for specialised insurance cover for non-standard home and motor insurance policies.

This role perfectly blends sales execution with high-quality customer service, ensuring all clients receive tailored advice that matches their insurance needs.

Key Responsibilities
- Sales & Business Development: Contact provided leads to quote, sell, and cross-sell personal lines insurance products (home and car insurance).
- Customer Relationship Management: Provide expert advice to new and existing customers regarding policy adjustments, mid-term amendments, and renewals.
- Target Achievement: Meet and exceed personal monthly sales targets while maintaining excellent quality standards.
- Compliance & FCA Regulation: Ensure all sales practices strictly adhere to the guidelines set by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).
- Client Retention: Handle customer queries and complaints with empathy, professionalism, and speed to maximize retention.
- Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear and professional communication with insurance companies, underwriters, and internal branch managers.

What We Are Looking For (Skills & Requirements)
- Entry-Level Candidates Welcome: No prior insurance experience is required; full training is provided.
- Strong Communication Skills: An excellent telephone manner with the ability to build rapport quickly.
- Target-Driven Mindset: Motivation to work towards individual and team sales targets.
- Problem-Solving Ability: A customer-focused approach to handling queries and resolving complaints calmly.
- Professionalism: Ability to act as a corporate ambassador for the company at all times.

What's in It for You?
- Competitive Salary: £21,000 - £26,000 per annum.
- Comprehensive Training: Learn everything you need to know about the insurance sector from industry experts.
- Career Growth: A structured pathway into professional insurance and financial services roles.
- Stable Environment: A full-time, permanent position within a supportive local branch.

About Us:

Massenhove Recruitment Limited is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We recruit solely on merit, treating all candidates with equality, fairness, and respect.

Apply Today: If you are ready to kickstart a dynamic career in insurance sales, apply now for a confidential discussion!

title: Private Client Advisor
description:
Private Client Advisor Permanent Full-Time Suffolk or London

We are working with a well-established professional services organisation seeking a Private Client Advisor to join their specialist team. This is a broad-ranging role covering will drafting, lasting powers of attorney, and full estate administration, with significant client interaction.

The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering high-quality trustee and executorship services while building long-term relationships with clients and their families.

Key Responsibilities

Will Writing
- Drafting Wills and related documents based on client instructions received via email, telephone, or meetings (in person or virtual).
- Discussing instructions and responding to technical queries from clients and professional advisors, both in writing and at meetings.
- Maintaining accurate and compliant records relating to Wills.
- Processing will-writing fees.
- Managing queries and correspondence relating to inoperative will appointments.
- Reviewing existing Wills and advising on updates where appropriate.

Lasting Powers of Attorney
- Drafting Lasting Powers of Attorney (LPAs) based on client instructions.
- Liaising with clients, family members, and advisors to discuss instructions and address queries.
- Registering, administering, and overseeing appointments where a corporate trustee is acting as Attorney under an Enduring Power of Attorney (EPA), and managing all matters arising as a result.
- Assisting with reviews of existing LPAs.

Executorships & Estate Administration

You will handle estate administration matters from initial notification of death through to final completion, including:
- Meeting with bereaved families and providing guidance throughout the administration process.
- Arranging property insurance and appointing solicitors where required.
- Preparing information to support probate applications.
- Liaising with investment managers, tax specialists, and wealth planning teams as appropriate.
- Advising beneficiaries on inheritance tax matters, making distributions, and arranging payments to HMRC.
- Collecting in estate assets and preparing estate accounts, allocation statements, and R185 certificates.
- Ensuring records are well maintained and easily accessible.
- Developing strong family relationships and identifying opportunities to retain assets and introduce new business.

Skills & Experience
- Sound knowledge of wills and lasting powers of attorney, with practical experience in these areas.
- Awareness of post-death tax planning opportunities, including Deeds of Variation.
- Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to deal sensitively and professionally with bereaved clients.
- Confidence handling estates comprising a wide range of asset types.
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to keep beneficiaries, co-executors, and trustees informed both verbally and in writing.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise competing matters effectively.
- Commercial awareness and the ability to recognise and progress new business opportunities appropriately.
- Full STEP qualified or progressing towards their studies. Additional support and funding are available (desirable)

Interested?

For a confidential discussion about this opportunity and further details, please contact Sophie Clarke at Reed (Norwich) and/or apply today!
